gloss: to wear down, to be worn away

definitions.gloss: to wear down, to be worn away, to erode
definitions.explanation: To become thinner or smaller through friction or repeated use. Used for physical objects and figuratively for mental energy.

examples.japanese: タイヤが{擦|す}り{減|へ}っている。
{靴底|くつぞこ}が{擦|す}り{減|へ}って{滑|すべ}りやすくなった。
examples.english: The soles of my shoes have worn down and become slippery.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}のクレーム{対応|たいおう}で{神経|しんけい}が{擦|す}り{減|へ}る。
examples.english: Dealing with complaints every day wears my nerves down.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xが{擦|す}り{減|へ}る.
Transitive pair: {擦|す}り{減|へ}らす (to wear something down)

WORD FORMATION:
{擦|す}る (to rub) + {減|へ}る (to decrease) = to decrease through rubbing

ASPECT (ている):
{擦|す}り{減|へ}っている indicates a resulting state of being worn down.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タイヤが{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: tires wear down
- {靴底|くつぞこ}が{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: shoe soles wear away
- {神経|しんけい}が{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: nerves get frayed
- {歯|は}が{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: teeth get worn down
